{{actor|name=ovl_Door_Shutter|ispage=true}}

'''ovl_Door_Shutter''' is the Lifting Dungeon Door [[Actor]]. <br>

== General Notes ==

When a Lifting Dungeon Door is created, it needs the object it depends on to render.<br>
To get this object, it looks up its type (Variable & 0x03C0) in the Design Table.<br>
If the Design Table value is 80+ (usually FF), the Scene Table is used to choose an object from the Object Table.<br>
If the Design Table value is lower than 80, it will use that value to choose an object from the Object Table directly.<br>
